diagnostics.message: When `var.project_create` is true, `google_project_service.project_services` enables APIs in a project that must first be created. Its current project ID expression does not establish an ordering edge to `google_project.project`.
When creating a new project, the service-account configuration operates on that project but has no dependency edge to `google_project.project`; it can therefore run before the project exists.

The API service identities are generated in the newly created project when `var.project_create` is true, so `google_project_service_identity.jit_si` must wait for `google_project.project` to exist. The current ordering through API enablement is not connected to project creation.
`google_org_policy_policy.default` targets a project identified by `local.project.project_id`; when this module creates that project, policy creation must wait until `google_project.project` exists.

`google_project_iam_custom_role.roles` creates roles in the project and must wait for `google_project.project` when the module is creating the project; its project argument uses a local value and provides no graph edge to project creation.
